eval.title: BYND Stock Analysis - Beyond Meat Investing Outlook (+ Valuation)

call.headline_quote: so be very very careful when investing in this because the fundamentals are simply not there from a fundamental perspective

base_metric.name: other
base_metric.quote: i started here with inputting revenues 0.4 billion here is the growth rate my usual 10 discount rate for comparative reasons and i have used the terminal multiple of two on the revenues as valuation

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: if i put these numbers into evaluation the present value the intrinsic value is 3.2 billion

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: if they grow faster assuming a p ratio of 50 higher or 45 on a price to sales terminal multiple of free that is now 21 given the 400 million sales then i get to a present value justifiable of almost 7 billion

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: in a worst case scenario where the growth risk is 20 then 15 still assuming they achieve profitability in the terminal multiple let's leave it at 2 then i am at 1.34 billion

what_is_priced_in.quote: 400 million they need to increase sales 12 times in the next 10 years so that's three times the market for plant-based meat things

reasons.claim: Even summing best, normal and worst case scenarios the intrinsic value of 3.6 billion is far below the 9 billion market cap.
reasons.quote: if i sum the scenarios normal best case worst case i get to 3.6 billion at best for evaluation compared to the market cap of 9 billion

data_check.gap_note: he says 9e+09, as-of 2.69612e+11 (FY2020); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: summed intrinsic value

reasons.claim: Blind taste testing showed no meaningful difference from a much cheaper private-label competitor, undermining the premium price and implying margins must fall.
reasons.quote: there is not much different into the ingredients

data_check.gap_note: he says 7, as-of 4291.8 (2021-06-03); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: The new 1.15 billion convertible note leaves the company deeply in debt relative to its 400 million in revenue, and if growth disappoints bondholders could end up owning much of the company.
reasons.quote: the key fundamental here is the company is now 1.15 billion dollars in debt so if the company doesn't grow as expected then the bondholders might say okay now give us more shares

data_check.gap_note: he says 1.15e+09, as-of 2.5e+07 (FY2020); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Reaching the assumed valuation requires 12x revenue growth, roughly three times today's entire plant-based meat market, which he views as unrealistic given the taste test.
reasons.quote: they need to increase sales 12 times in the next 10 years so that's three times the market for plant-based meat things as we have seen

data_check.gap_note: he says 12, as-of 0.365522 (FY2020); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: The stock is being driven by meme-stock/Reddit speculation and greater-fool dynamics rather than fundamentals, which historically ends badly.
reasons.quote: it's now a hot mimi stock or something like that so and that's also the reason for the crazy ups and downs of the stock over the last month
